subject: Q3 Budget Review — Action Required by Friday
body:
Hi,

Please review the attached Q3 budget proposal and provide your feedback by end of day Friday.

Key items that need your input:
1. Marketing spend increase (15% YoY) — do you approve?
2. Engineering headcount: 3 new hires in H2 — which team gets priority?
3. Travel budget reduction from $50k to $30k — any concerns?

Thanks,
Alice
